thread:
maria: Quick sync — we need to decide header precedence for per-customer routing overrides. Example: X-Org-Route vs X-Route-Override vs org header. Who has priority? This affects quotas + sticky routing. TL;DR: propose explicit priority order and TTLed exceptions.

jake: +1. Current runtime checks: header X-Customer-Routing then org header then default route. But that was a hack. We should formalize.

lee: If we pick header-first, we risk tenants spoofing unless header is signed. Need allowlist + HMAC. Also quota enforcement needs to tie to resulting route not incoming header.

maria: exact. We need policy: 1) authenticated signed override header (HMAC) -> takes precedence, 2) org-scoped console pin (manual) -> next, 3) default routing rules.

sam: How to represent TTL? console should let support set expiry; runtime needs fast eviction. Proposal: include expiry in the signed token payload: "exp": 1700000000. Example token format:
```
X-Route-Override: vm=redwood:theta;route=gpu-pool-3;exp=1700000000;sig=...
```

lee: love format but runtime must validate signature + check audit log. Also add "reason" field for support traceability.

jake: what about quotas? If override routes to Dedicated, we must bill against org reserved capacity, not hosted. So routing decision must return (route, billing_account).

maria: agree. Also UX: console should show active overrides, who created them, TTL, reason, and an option for immediate revoke.

infra-bot: Note: RFC 2026 created. Please add design doc to eng-platform/drive.automation

sam: +1. I'll draft PR for runtime changes: accept signed header format, check HMAC, map to route & billing, emit audit event "route.override.applied".

jake: add fallback behavior: if signature invalid or route unavailable -> log + fall back to org pin -> then default. No silent drop.

lee: and unit tests for edge cases (expired, malformed, billing_mismatch).

maria: Can someone sketch the protobuf change for route decision? small snippet would help.

sam: put this in the PR, rough proto field:
```
message RouteDecision {
  string route = 1;
  string billing_account = 2;
  repeated string reasons = 3; // e.g. ["override:header", "fallback:org_pin"]
}
```

jake: Also flag for "audit_token" so console can revoke based on id. We'll need index on audit_token in events DB.

maria: OK next steps: sam PR, jake update runtime and tests, lee console UX mockups + revoke flow, I'll coordinate with support for permissions. Thanks :raised_hands: 

sam: ETA for PR EOD Friday.

lee: I'll mock screenshots by Thursday.

jake: I'll allocate an infra review slot for next Tues.

maria: Great. Closing thread for now — file follow-ups in the RFC PR. :thumbsup:
